rationale: The last surviving member of bugs_open/203's fabricate-a-URL class, found 2026-08-22 while closing bugs_open/071's residuals. buildRenderContextFromDB (section_editor_actions.go:660) seeds ContentData["cta_text"]="Get Started" and ContentData["cta_url"]="/contact.html" at :783-785, BEFORE the stored content_data merge at :788-792 — so a section whose content carries no CTA fields renders a fabricated English button pointing at /contact.html, a 404 on any site without that page (071's relojistas evidence: the same default class shipped 'Get Started' -> /contact.html on a Spanish site whose contact page is /contacto.html). The mechanism is the one 071 stated sharply on 2026-07-27: the default fires upstream of the template guard, so it does not merely supply a bad value — it MANUFACTURES the very condition the {{if and .cta_text .cta_url}} guard tests for, making 'no CTA here' unrepresentable in content_data. 203's other members were removed on exactly this ruling (880a405a6 deleted the scalar cta_url defaults, council-approved 42eda9a5; 2817f6661 deleted the contextToMap map defaults on 2026-08-21) and component_library.go's surviving builder contextToInterfaceMap is documented correct-or-absent (LNK-005, :1272-1279) — this call path re-introduces the phantom one layer up, on the section-edit routes (applyContentEdit :1052, applyComponentSwap :1199) that write rendered_html straight to live pages. Deleting the two seeds makes the CTA control correct-or-absent on this path too: cta_url renders absent (guarded templates omit the anchor; RenderTemplate additionally reports a 'URL attribute rendered empty — dead control' and the path escalates via emitRequiredFieldsMissing), and cta_text falls through to the fleet label default which is harmless because the anchor is gated on cta_url. Blast radius measured before writing: 29 of 30 active content_components referencing cta_url carry an {{if ... cta_url}} guard; the one exception (loans-damage-checker-loanzy-uk) supplies its own content_data values, so its exposure is edit-time only and it never relied on this default. No test pins the deleted lines.

plan.summary: Delete the pre-merge cta_text/cta_url defaults in buildRenderContextFromDB so the section-edit render path becomes correct-or-absent like every other member of 203's class.

edits.rationale: The seeds run before the content_data merge, so an absent CTA is refilled and the refilled pair satisfies the template guard — the exact mechanism 071 proved by accident on relojistas (deleting cta_text from content_data produced an English 'Get Started' -> /contact.html on a Spanish site). Only removing the default lets the guard do its job.

plan.risks: A section edited while its content_data genuinely lacks CTA fields loses the fabricated button instead of shipping a wrong link — the ruled direction (203's precedent, council-approved). Any page whose current appearance depends on the fabricated default on a site that HAS /contact.html would lose that button on its next section edit; that is the correct outcome and the class the guard exists for, but it is a visible change on the edit path. The unguarded loans-damage-checker-loanzy-uk template supplies its own values and is unaffected in production; named here rather than silently passed. Inert until a chassis image roll.
